title: Sable and the Tide
author: Bram Iversen
blurb: Rafael Thornbury, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
